Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on a bed, staring at the floor, his hands clenched into fists 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months. I know what's best for you 🤝.

JACK:
(getting up from the bed) I don't need your help! I can take care of myself! 💪

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, sit down. You're not going anywhere 🚫.

JACK:
(suddenly calm) Fine. But if I don't like what I see, I'm out of here! 👋

Dr. Smith hesitates for a moment, then reaches for the pills on his desk 💊. He hands them to Jack, who takes them and swallows them down 💦.

JACK:
(smiling) Ah, that's better. Now I can see things clearly again 🔍.

DR. SMITH:
(surprised) What do you mean?

JACK:
(looking around the room) I mean, I can see that you're not who you say you are. You're not a doctor at all. You're just a figment of my imagination! 🤯

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he looks around the room, realizing that Jack is right 🤔. He looks down at his hands and sees that they're not his own 👀.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) No... it can't be...

JACK:
(laughing) Ah, but it is! You're just a product of my own paranoid delusions! 🤪

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's face contorts in a mixture of shock and realization 😱. The screen fades to black as the sound of Dr. Smith's maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
